description:
Generate and edit HappyHorse videos, then retrieve the same video task through Ace Data Cloud. Independently provided by Ace Data Cloud; not the model vendor's official integration.

1. Install this server from Smithery in your client.
2. Register or sign in to [Ace Data Cloud Applications](https://platform.acedata.cloud/console/applications?utm_source=opensource&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=evergreen&utm_content=happyhorse_smithery_api_key). Initialize General application if needed, then copy its API Key or create a dedicated key. Check service access, expiry, limits and balance.
3. In the connection's apiKey / API Token field, paste only the token, without Bearer. Complete sign-in when prompted.
4. Query happyhorse_get_task with an existing task's task_id; do not submit generation again while pending.

Generation is metered; see [current pricing](https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/happyhorse?utm_source=opensource&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=evergreen&utm_content=happyhorse_smithery_pricing). A platform- account token cannot replace the application API Key.
